transport: UTF-8 JSONL over child process stdin/stdout; stdout contains JSON only; stderr is diagnostics
preview_extension: preview-contract-v1.json; only preview events may use up to 196608 bytes excluding LF; control requests and responses retain 8192
optional_start_preview: top-level boolean preview; only true opts this job into preview events. Missing or false retains the original v2 8192-byte/event behavior. Invalid types rejected. Not part of plan or validate_plan.

plan.output_directory: existing writable absolute directory, no symlink path components

response.request_id: echo or null for unparseable envelope

validate_plan_data.plan: normalized plan plus requested_records and expected_file_bytes

event.state: same fields as status_data; no request_id

cancel_data.state: current state; terminal cancellation arrives as job_status event

shutdown: response data.accepted=true; cancels and joins worker before exit; EOF does the same without response
publication: CAPDDR2-compatible BIN, exclusive temporary creation, CRC/index/tick validation and existing vibration::load_capture validation; sidecar published before unique BIN; failure/cancel produces no successful BIN; fsync file and directory
source: --test-fixture is explicit host QA only and always synthetic. --hardware-self-test explicitly requests the real driver START_TEST_PATTERN; it is mutually exclusive with --test-fixture. Only actual driver status.flags together with matching hardware hw_status bit6 establish the source. A real TEST source forces synthetic=true. Missing hardware stays unavailable in either production mode. Normal GUI startup must pass neither flag. Physical ADC captures remain source-unconfirmed and uncalibrated.

capabilities_source_fields.actual_source: unknown|adc|hardware_self_test|host_fixture, established source readback or explicit host fixture
